skills.name: Dark Exchange
skills.description:
Bargain with darkness to restore |cffffff8160|r Health and |cffffff3600|r Magicka instantly, and an additional |cffffff2400|r Magicka over |cffffff20|r seconds. 

The exchange also grants you Minor Berserk for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing your damage done by |cffffff5|r%.

skills.name: Fire Rune
skills.description:
Inscribe a rune of cosmic fire on the earth, which takes |cffffff2|r seconds to arm and lasts for |cffffff22|r seconds.

When triggered, the rune blasts all enemies in the target area for |cffffff10800|r Flame Damage.

skills.name: Equilibrium
skills.description:
Barter with Oblivion to trade vitality for power, sacrificing your Health in exchange for |cffffff3000|r Magicka.

The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

skills.name: Degeneration
skills.description:
Bind an enemy with chaotic magic, dealing |cffffff21024|r Magic Damage over |cffffff22|r seconds.

Excess magic spills out from them, granting you Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff22|r seconds.

skills.name: Inner Light
skills.description:
Conjure a mote of magelight, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies around you for |cffffff7|r seconds. Exposed enemies cannot return to stealth or invisibility for |cffffff4|r seconds. The light is so brilliant that you cannot conceal your presence while active.

While slotted gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r% and your Max Magicka is increased by |cffffff5|r%.

skills.name: Shooting Star
skills.description:
Call a comet down from the constellations to blast an enemy, dealing |cffffff18899|r Flame Damage to all enemies in the area, knocking them down, and stunning them for |cffffff2|r seconds.

One second after impact, enemies in the target area take |cffffff5110|r Flame Damage every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff12|r seconds.

You generate |cffffff10|r Ultimate for each enemy hit by the initial blast, up to 6 times.
